Name: Stereo Segment Image Diagnostic Point Data
Description: This TRE contains segment model diagnostic point data to include X and Y coordinates, elevation, segment ID, and number of diagnostic points.

SISEGID.Name: Segment Model ID
SISEGID.Description: This field indicates the ID of the segment model.

NBRDP.Name: Number of Diagnostic Points
NBRDP.Description: This field indicates the number of diagnostic points per segment model.

LATDP<NBRDP>.Name: Latitude of Diagnostic Point
LATDP<NBRDP>.Description: This field indicates the latitude of the diagnostic point.

LONDP<NBRDP>.Name: Longitude of Diagnostic Point
LONDP<NBRDP>.Description: This field indicates the longitude of the diagnostic point.

ELVDP<NBRDP>.Name: Elevation of Diagnostic Point
ELVDP<NBRDP>.Description: This field indicates the elevation of the diagnostic point.

XICLDP<NBRDP>.Name: X Image Coordinate of Left Image Segment
XICLDP<NBRDP>.Description: This field indicates the X image coordinate of the left image segment.

YICLDP<NBRDP>.Name: Y Image Coordinate of Left Image Segment
YICLDP<NBRDP>.Description: This field indicates the Y image coordinate of the left image segment.

XICRDP<NBRDP>.Name: X Image Coordinate of Right Image Segment
XICRDP<NBRDP>.Description: This field indicates the X image coordinate of the right image segment.

YICRDP<NBRDP>.Name: Y Image Coordinate of Right Image Segment
YICRDP<NBRDP>.Description: This field indicates the Y image coordinate of the right image segment.
